## Appearance

Blythe has gray-green eyes that shine with a distinct luster and brilliancy in the dusk. As of the fifth volume, Blythe also features red hair.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017)_

## Personality

Blythe possesses notable skill in strategic generalship. They are recognized for marshalling campaigns and originating innovative tactics.

## History

Dr. David Blythe practiced medicine at [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary for fifty years. In February, he and his family departed for a three-month trip to attend a medical congress in [London](../codex/places.md#london).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P10](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P35](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0035), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P43](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0043), [v5 CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE P48](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0048)_

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/blythe--marilla-cuthbert.md)

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/blythe--faith.md)

[Faith](../character/faith.md) and the Blythe family became fast friends after meeting in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where the Blythe children shared their cooked trout and exchanged stories with the Meredith family. [Faith](../character/faith.md) acts as a comforting friend and playmate, spending time with the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to chat and socialize alongside the other neighborhood children.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), +9 more_

- Friend of — playmates and comforting friend (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P13](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0013)</sub>

### [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/blythe--una-meredith.md)

[Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) and the Blythe family established a close bond as sworn friends and allies after meeting in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). The children frequently gather together in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to talk and support one another, such as when [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md) encourages [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) to visit [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) on behalf of the runaway orphan [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), +12 more_

- Friend of — sworn friends and allies (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045)</sub>
